review.summary: The fix commit e96a3a9 resolves the single finding from round 1 and introduces no new issues. It changes only docs/TESTING.md and AI-FIRST-ENGINEERING-HANDBOOK.md, adding Format check before Lint to the CI Expectations pipeline and to the handbook's step 12 and CI/CD Policy pipelines, so all four CI pipeline lists now match step 12 of docs/AI-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW.md and the frontend-checks job. A repository search found no other pipeline list without the format check. The only frontend command blocks without pnpm format:check are in existing task files and in the feature-specific Structure and Summary blocks of docs/TESTING.md, both of which the task excludes. The reformat commit and the CI, Makefile and documentation commit are unchanged since round 1, and origin/main has not moved, so no rebase was needed. On the head, make frontend-check (format check, lint, 22 test files and build) and the review-record validator passed.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: Commit e96a3a9 adds Format check before Lint to the CI pipeline lists in docs/TESTING.md and in both places in AI-FIRST-ENGINEERING-HANDBOOK.md, matching docs/AI-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW.md step 12.
